table.retrieve:
SELECT 
	supplier=(select name from accounts where accounts.acccode=OH.suppcode),
	customer=(select name from accounts where accounts.acccode=OH.custcode),
	OrderDate=OH.date,
	OrderCode=OH.pocode,
	Posted = OH.Posted,
	Itemalias=I.customicode,
	itemname=I.name,
	POPrice=OD.rate,
	POQty=OD.qty,
	PurQty=(SELECT isnull(sum(PD.packqty),0) FROM purledger PL , purdetail PD WHERE PL.POCode=OH.pocode AND PL.PurInvCode = PD.PurInvCode)
FROM PurOrderHeader OH,
	PurOrderDetail OD,
	Item I	
WHERE OH.Date >= :ad_sdate AND
	OH.Date<=:ad_edate AND
	OH.Suppcode=:ai_suppcode AND
	OH.pocode=OD.pocode AND
	I.icode=OD.icode
Order By  OrderCode,
			 OD.PoRowid
